subject: Human Resource Development and Organizational Behavior
description: This course provides insights into human behavior in organizations and emphasizes the development of human resources for organizational effectiveness. It explores motivation, leadership, teamwork, communication, and personal development in professional settings.
objectives: Understand the fundamentals of human behavior in organizations.
Analyze individual and group dynamics within organizational contexts.
Explore leadership, motivation, and communication theories.
Recognize the importance of organizational culture and change management.
Enhance interpersonal and professional development skills.
course_outcomes: Explain the role of human behavior in effective organizational functioning.
Apply motivation and leadership theories to real-world organizational issues.
Demonstrate skills for effective communication and teamwork.
Analyze organizational culture and change management processes.
Develop personal and professional skills to enhance workplace performance.

modules.title: Introduction to Organizational Behavior
topics: Definition, Nature, and Scope of Organizational Behavior
Challenges and Opportunities in Organizational Behavior
OB Models – Autocratic, Custodial, Supportive, Collegial

modules.title: Individual Behavior and Motivation
topics: Perception – Process and Errors in Perception
Motivation Concepts – Maslow, Herzberg, McGregor, Alderfer, McClelland

modules.title: Group Dynamics and Teamwork
topics: Group Formation and Types of Groups

modules.title: Leadership and Communication
topics: Leadership Theories – Trait, Behavioral, and Contingency Approaches
Communication Process, Barriers, and Feedback Mechanisms

modules.title: Organizational Culture and Change
topics: Concept and Dimensions of Organizational Culture
Organizational Change – Forces, Resistance, and Overcoming Resistance

suggested_books: Stephen P. Robbins and Timothy A. Judge, Organizational Behavior, 18th Edition, Pearson
K. Aswathappa, Organizational Behavior, Himalaya Publishing House
reference_books: Fred Luthans, Organizational Behavior: An Evidence-Based Approach, McGraw-Hill Education
Uday Pareek, Understanding Organizational Behavior, Oxford University Press
